label: 32 Chunk
hook: Defending champion. Broken jaw, still huge.
id: Big muzzle scar and a protruding canine from a 2025 jaw fracture.
story: First identified in 2007. Barely seen this summer until September, then returned with a low-hanging belly. Nobody knows where he ate.

label: 89 Backpack
id: Blond ears, light brown fur going grizzled, few visible wounds.
story: Son of champion Holly, named for riding on her back as a cub in 2006. Survived a bad leg injury in 2007. Gets prime spots without much fighting.

label: 131 Marshmallow
hook: Fatter than she has ever been.
id: Blond ears, dark eye rings, short muzzle, light brown to blond fur.
story: Born 2018, independent in 2020. Never seen with cubs yet, but her size and fishing keep improving every year.

hook: Lost a cub for days in July. Got it back.
id: Large, grizzled dark brown, forward-leaning ears, wide belly. A chevron of fur on her forehead.
story: First identified in 2009, now on her fourth litter. One cub wandered alone for several days before the family reunited in the lower river. Believed to be 806’s mother. First Fat Bear Week.

label: 151 Walker
id: Dark brown, pear-shaped body, long muzzle, large round ears.
story: A playful young bear who now challenges rivals instead. Younger males like Bucky and Gully are closing in on his rank.

label: 164 Bucky
hook: Nine years old and still growing.
id: Grizzled brown, blond-tipped ears, a line of darker fur near his eyes.
story: First identified in 2019. Invented his own spot at the edge of the plunge pool under the falls. Now displaces most bears and picks fights for dominance.

hook: Fourth generation of a Brooks River dynasty.
id: Prominent shoulder hump, grizzled brown fur, blond-tipped ears.
story: Born 2008 to 708 Amelia, granddaughter of 438 Reggie, mother of 901. Bold since she was a cub and quick to defend her space and her cubs. Fans call her Electra.

label: 428 Studious
hook: Grazer’s daughter. Learned on the lip.
id: Small, short pointed muzzle, blond ears, grizzled blond fur late summer.
story: Born 2020. Fished the lip of the falls beside her mother as a cub, a spot most young bears never get. Now takes the lip when there’s room.

hook: On her own as a baby. Now raising her first litter.
id: Small, long muzzle, grizzled light brown fur. A large scar sometimes visible above her hips.
story: So small in 2015 that rangers thought she was a yearling, and she carried a healing wound from an attack. This summer she kept her first cubs safe. First Fat Bear Week.

hook: Raised by two moms. Now on her own.
id: Long tail, light brown fur that goes grizzled by late summer.
story: Born 2022 to 910, raised in the rare blended family of 910 and her sister 909. Independent since spring 2025.

hook: Too small for the falls. Working on it.
id: Round ears set high, uniform brown fur, hints of a lighter natal collar.
story: Born 2022, independent in 2025. Plays with other young bears, but will cut a play session short for a salmon.

hook: Adopted Grazer’s cub. Also the summer’s most feared mom.
id: Round blond-tipped ears, grizzled brown fur, a short mane early in summer.
story: Took in Biggie, a 2.5-year-old separated from 128 Grazer, alongside her own spring cub. In late July she killed 909’s cub. Neither villain nor hero. First Fat Bear Week.

hook: Lost one cub in June. The other is one of the biggest on the river.
id: Medium-sized, blond-rimmed triangle ears, golden brown fur turning grizzled.
story: First identified in 2018 as a subadult; a regular near the lodge, campground and river mouth. Gets fatter than most bears, which sets her cub up well.

label: 903 Gully
id: Grizzled brown, long straight muzzle, Eeyore-like sit on the lip.
story: Born 2016, believed to be Grazer’s son. In 2020 he started charging flocks of gulls. Now outranks older bears like Walker.

id: Large, brown fur, wide-set blond ears.
story: Born 2016, daughter of champion 409 Beadnose and sister of 910. Arrived with two cubs; lost one in June and the other to 806 in July. Plenty of fat anyway.

hook: Beadnose’s daughter, fishing wherever she wants.
id: Large, dark brown, prominent brow ridge, short forward-pointing ears.
story: Born 2016. Adopted her niece 609 in 2023, alone since 2025. Courted by Walker and Bucky this spring. Recognizable by her head lifts on the lip.
